display_name: LoRa W24 两组 Practical 监督的 CPU 正式 Full 测试
description: Run frozen E104 physical-packet Full CPU prediction for both predefined restoration arms after the r02 terminal train commits. No GPU waits or training by this evaluator.
authorization: User requested immediate Full formal test without waiting for GPUs.

code.environment: N607 pinned W24 CPU FP32, one prediction worker with two intraop and up to two channel generator CPU processes.
code.cwd: Formal CPU release controller then exact archived W24 environment for CPU children.

data.representation: Continuous 8192 complex samples at 1 MHz through DURA; untouched W24 front end receives the resulting packet.
data.physical_ids_ref: Closed r01 Practical source U_s bank (25200), ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver.
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.validation_ref: Registered LoRa source/target contract with independent source seed, namespace and packets.
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Known Practical source traces for supervised target only. Frozen recognizer and target unavailable during fit. Fixed Full test after freeze.

checkpoint.initialization: Reuse both exact r02 last-step (24,000) source checkpoints. No fit.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Registered source U and physical IDs for scratch fitting. All comparison checkpoints and frozen E104 opened only for post-freeze comparison.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Scratch arms. Only the frozen native-center source teacher supplies source scale targets for the equal-dose arm. W24 and historical models are frozen evaluation comparators.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Wait for only both preselected terminal weights; no source-V qualification. Real E104 source-only smoke, fixed all seven Full target scenes, independent truth-last score.

execution.gpu_policy: No GPU resources. CPU controller starts immediately and waits only for both source checkpoints to freeze.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on systemic technical/protocol failure, incompatible source or frozen comparator, collision, or prediction/scoring failure; preserve outputs. Both arms go to Full regardless of V accuracy. No stop for lack of GPU slots.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: w24_third_prior collect-score --native-practical-supervision --cpu-formal. Formal scorer runs independently after all shards close.
